source: Daniel's exercise list (2026-07-25), deduplicated and typed
notes: Replaces free-exercise-db as the seed source for library_exercises (SPEC-05 §6.1 image-licence gate is void; that dataset ships nothing).
`aka` records the original list wordings that collapsed into an entry, so nothing is silently lost on review.
`rig` is the movement-pattern animation id; `rig_params` are the per-exercise deltas applied to that pattern. See SPEC-07.
Dropped from the original list: 'Banded bridge' (requires a resistance band; not in the equipment vocabulary).
difficulty uses the existing CHECK constraint values: beginner | intermediate | expert.
